column1: # Skill tree layout (tab-separated).
# PARENT row: no leading tab. Center / gatekeeper node for this tier.
# CHILD rows: one leading TAB. GRANDCHILD rows: two tabs, directly under their parent child.
#   Grandchildren are supplementary dead-ends on the same row as the tier parent (see layout).
#   There are usually two child lines per parent; they are drawn ABOVE the parent (two → one).
#   Main trunk: only the first child row connects up to the tier parent; the parent unlocks
#   from the first child only. Previous parent still unlocks all children on the next row.
#   Side branches (2nd+ child) sit on the previous tier's parent row (horizontal stem, 3→9 o'clock).
# Columns (same for parent and child rows):
#   id
# unlocked: 1 = node may appear (0 = hard-disabled). Structural gates still apply (see skill_tree_unlock.dart).

# progress_source: none | people_01 | nature_pictographs_02 | pictographs_03 | pictographs_04 | radicals_01 | colors_01 | colors_02 | family_friends_01 | radicals_02 | radicals_03 | radicals_04 | pictograph_pool
# game_mode: pictographic | guess_radical | vocabulary | components | foundations | (empty = no tap)
# --- Puzzle-type invariants (locked; do not blur across modes) ---
# vocabulary ("word mode"): ALWAYS composition — user builds ONE target character by placing
#   2…N IDS component leaves (N capped at [VocabPuzzle.maxComponentAssemblyLeafCount] = 4 in code;
#   if a character needs more leaves, the round uses whole-glyph handling instead). Never the
#   pictogram-style "pick the Hanzi that matches the English" screen as the sole mechanic.
# pictographic: ALWAYS recognition — user picks which Hanzi matches the translation/clue.
#   Never assembling a character from components in this mode.
# guess_radical: ALWAYS recognition — user picks which component or glyph matches the English clue.
#   Never assembling a character from components in this mode.
# --- end invariants ---
# exercise_id: pictographic subset lecture id; radical course id for guess_radical; else empty
# pictograph_list_asset: optional bundled course TSV for pictographic mode puzzle rows. For
#   People / Nature subset lectures, use the same file as the lesson. If empty for exercise_id
#   people_01 or nature_pictographs_02, PuzzlePage still resolves the bundled lecture TSV from
#   exercise_id. Ignored for other game modes.
